run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py with input_dir and output_dir to extract version from configure.ac and write Version.h
extract_version_from_configure_ac: extract the major, minor, and fix version numbers from a configure.ac file using the AC_INIT macro regex
generate_version_header: generate a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines from configure.ac
review_versiongenerate_regex: review the non-greedy regex pattern that extracts three-part version strings from AC_INIT in configure.ac
refactor_versiongenerate_cli: refactor versiongenerate.py to use argparse instead of raw sys.argv for input_dir and output_dir arguments
